text: DeFi's distinctive disruption is that it attempts to make financial transactions permissionless, completely open to anybody, and borderless, promising reduced transaction costs, broader financial inclusion, and open access across borders.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Decentralization – Why We Need Technology Infrastructure Upgrades (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3808859
